objective: Milestone 11: Actual-Cost Settlement, Opportunity Translation Caching and Outbound Delivery Dispatching

tasks.description: Implement operational actual-cost token settlement and monthly budget rollover coordinator to reconcile estimated microdollar reservations against actual model usage, settle net microdollar balances, and manage calendar month budget transitions.
acceptance_criteria: settleActualCost(reservationId, usage, options) reconciles estimated microdollars with actual model prompt and completion token counts from provider responses
Computes refunds for over-reserved estimates or charges incremental microdollars when usage exceeds estimate within safety caps
rolloverBudgetPeriod(currentPeriod, options) handles calendar month boundaries, archives past period spending aggregates, and resets spend meters to zero for the new month
Enforces hard ceiling invariants and reports anomalies when actual spend exceeds reserved bounds
Deterministic in-memory / SQL-compatible state transitions with comprehensive input validation and safe error handling
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/cost-settlement.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement reviewed opportunity translation caching and content revision invalidation manager to store multilingual translations tagged with source content hashes and invalidate stale translations upon source changes.
acceptance_criteria: getOpportunityTranslation(opportunityId, targetLocale, sourceContentHash) retrieves cached translation or returns cache miss / stale status
cacheOpportunityTranslation(opportunityId, targetLocale, sourceContentHash, translationPayload, options) stores validated translations tagged with model/reviewer metadata and source content hash
invalidateTranslations(opportunityId, newContentHash, options) invalidates or marks stale all translations associated with prior source revisions
Enforces locale support (en, zh-Hans) and rejects malformed payloads, mismatched hashes, or unreviewed machine outputs when strict review is required
Deterministic in-memory state transitions with safe error handling and zero unhandled rejections
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/translation-cache.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement live outbound delivery transport dispatcher to bind leased delivery intents from the intent queue to concrete transport adapters (email with RFC 8058 headers and Telegram Bot API), formatting payloads, enforcing circuit breaker checks, and returning structured receipts.
acceptance_criteria: dispatchDeliveryIntent(intent, transport, options) maps an acquired delivery intent into channel-specific payloads (email with RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers or Telegram formatted Markdown)
Dispatches through injected transport interface with configurable network timeout signals and retry headers
Normalizes provider responses into standardized receipts (status: "accepted" | "retry" | "failed" | "suppressed", external reference ID, timestamp)
Handles network errors, timeouts, HTTP 429 rate limits, and provider errors safely without uncaught rejections
Pure domain logic and safe error handling conforming to delivery queue interfaces
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/transport-dispatcher.test.ts && npm run typecheck
